about.label: About the group
about.title: An atelier with a history
texts: QUEEN Fashion Group brings together seven wedding dress brands under one roof — from the signature QUEEN line to younger labels with their own handwriting.

Every dress is made by hand in our own production, where each stage is controlled, from the choice of fabric to the final decoration. We supply salons, boutiques and showrooms across Europe and present our collections at Barcelona Bridal Fashion Week, Bridal Fashion Warsaw and Fiera Milano.

story.title: Seven bridal brands under one roof, made in our own production
texts: QUEEN Fashion Group grew out of QUEEN — a wedding dress brand known for structured corset bodices, fine lace and long trains. Today the group brings together seven brands, from the signature QUEEN line to younger labels with their own handwriting.
We work with the owners of wedding salons, boutiques and showrooms. Partners order from our catalogues or ask for exclusive individual tailoring, and we take both large wholesale and small orders.
Our managers help each salon find its way through the assortment: which models and colours are in demand this season, and which payment and delivery method suits them best.

craft.title: Made by hand, checked at every stage
craft.text: Every dress is sewn in our own production. Each model is worked out for the required size, so it fits as it should — whether it comes from the catalogue or is made to order.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: The controller of your personal data is QUEEN_WED Sp. z o.o., Czyżówka 14/2.11, 30-526 Kraków, Poland. For any question about your data, write to {email}.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.text: When you send a wholesale enquiry we receive the data you enter in the form: your name, the name of your salon or company, e-mail address, phone number, country, the brands you are interested in and your message. When you call or write to a manager we receive the data you share in that conversation.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: We use this data only to answer your enquiry, send price lists and catalogues, prepare and carry out orders, and keep in touch as a business partner. The legal basis is the steps taken at your request before entering into a contract and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR), or your consent where we ask for it.

sections.title: Who receives it
sections.text: Your data is available to our managers. We may share it with providers who help us run our business — e-mail and hosting services, a customer relationship management system, and delivery companies such as DPD for shipping orders. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: We keep enquiry data for as long as needed to answer it and continue the conversation, and data related to orders for the period required by accounting and tax law.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You have the right to access your data, correct it, have it deleted, restrict or object to its processing, and receive it in a portable format. Where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time. You can also lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO) in Poland.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: This website does not use advertising or analytics cookies. If that changes, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where required.
